# Architecture Decision Records

An ADR records **one significant decision**: the context, the options considered, what was chosen
and why. The decision of an accepted ADR is never rewritten: corrections and as-built notes are
appended as dated `## Amendment YYYY-MM-DD` sections, and a changed decision needs a new ADR that
supersedes the old one (whose status becomes `Superseded by NNNN`).

Architecture site: <https://num-bbro.github.io/rust-factory/>

- Source: each ADR is a `Constraint` element in `docs/architecture/model.xml` (identifier
  `id-mot-adr-NNNN`) whose documentation is the text. These pages are generated by `just model-docs`
  and never edited by hand; [template.md](template.md) says how to add an ADR.
- Format: [MADR](https://adr.github.io/madr/).
- Status: `Proposed` (in an open PR) → `Accepted` (PR merged) → `Superseded by NNNN` / `Deprecated`.
- Links: the core elements that implement a decision *realize* its Constraint, the motivation
  elements that shaped it *influence* it, and a new ADR has a directed Association `supersedes` to
  the ADR it replaces.
